name: cslib-community/complexitylib (Complexity.Computability.QueryComplexity, DecisionTree, Communication, Foundations.BooleanAnalysis, Probability)
provides: Total Boolean functions BooleanFunction n := BitString n -> Bool. DecisionTree (inductive, eval, depth, queries, Computes, graft, queryAll), DecisionTree.complexity. Sensitivity: sensitivity, sensitivityAt, sensitivityFor, spectralSensitivity, sensitivityGraph. Block sensitivity (flipBlock, IsSensitiveBlock, blockSensitivity/At/For), certificateComplexity/At/For, degree (exact, = totalDegree of sign val), approxDegree. Relations: certificateComplexity_le_blockSensitivity_sq, certificateComplexity_le_sensitivity_mul_blockSensitivity, complexity_le_blockSensitivityFor_mul_certificateComplexityFor, complexity_le_degree_mul_blockSensitivity, complexity_le_two_mul_degree_pow_three (Midrijanis), blockSensitivity_le_two_mul_degree_sq and blockSensitivity_le_six_mul_approxDegree_sq (Nisan-Szegedy), degree_le_sensitivity_sq / sqrt_degree_le_sensitivity (Huang), complexity_le_two_mul_sensitivity_pow_six, certificateComplexity_le_two_mul_sensitivity_pow_five. Randomized: RandomizedDecisionTree (distribution over trees via StdSimplex), errorProb, Computes mu eps f, randomizedComplexity, Nisan: blockSensitivity_le_three_mul_randomizedComplexity, approxDegree_le_randomizedComplexity, complexity_le_mul_randomizedComplexity_pow_three. Yao: distributionalError, distributionalComplexity, randomizedComplexity_eq_iSup_distributionalComplexity, exists_distributionalComplexity_eq_randomizedComplexity. Sensitivity separation: port of the OpenAI result (exists_mul_sensitivity_sq_lt_blockSensitivity, exists_sensitivity_rpow_le_complexity, exists_mul_sensitivity_sq_lt_certificateComplexity). Quantum side: Quantum/Adversary (spectralSensitivity_le_thirty_six_mul, complexity_le_mul_pow_four), Quantum/Polynomial (approxDegree_le_two_mul, blockSensitivity_le_eight_mul_sq, complexity_le_mul_pow_six), Grover, Search, Composition. Fourier on the cube: chi, chiChar : AddChar, chi_mul_chi, DecisionTree/Fourier (fourierCoeff_eq_zero_of_depth_lt), BooleanAnalysis (Influence, Noise, Hypercontractivity incl. Bonami and tensorization, KahnKalaiLinial, FriedgutJunta, Symmetrization, LowDegree, MultilinearExtension, SignApproximation). Hadamard: HadamardRectangles (card_mul_le_two_pow_of_dotProduct_eq, sq_sum_mul_signVal_dotProduct_le), Hadamard code BLR. Markov Brothers inequality (sqrt_mul_abs_eval_derivative_le, sub_mul_abs_eval_derivative_le) behind Nisan-Szegedy degree bounds. Probability: StdSimplex minimax (exists_forall_sum_le_of_forall_exists_sum_le), PMF algebra (PMF/Expect, Bind, Map, Uniform), Chernoff (pi_sum_ge_le_exp), Concentration, BoundedDifferences (McDiarmid-style), KWiseIndependent, AdaptiveWeights. Communication: Protocol, DagProtocol, Randomized, Distributional (ecomplexity_le_iff_forall_distributionalComplexity_le), Newman, Discrepancy, Lifting (Gadget, Simulation), Rectangle, KarchmerWigderson. Circuit/Boolean/WeightedThreshold/TranscriptTree.
paper_needs_covered: Boolean functions (total only; promise/partial functions only in Classes/Promise for languages, not for query functions)
Fourier analysis on the Boolean cube
Markov brothers inequality (not the finite-space Markov inequality)
Hadamard matrices (rectangle and dot-product lemmas only)
concentration and minimax on finite spaces
communication-complexity direct-product-adjacent lifting (not a direct product theorem)
maintenance_state: very active: commits within hours of 2026-11-01, 5,095 Lean files, AI-assisted development with Comparator suites; API still moving (toolchain v4.36.0-rc2).
notes: Strongest single find. Same Lean/Mathlib toolchain as current mathlib master. Statements are for total functions BooleanFunction n; the paper's partial functions (promise problems) must be added by us. No direct-product theorem and no explicit Hadamard-matrix/multiplicative-weights-over-Boolean-cube development was found; AdaptiveWeights and Probability/Minimax should be read before deciding. Query model is a tree over bit queries (alphabet Bool), so non-Boolean-alphabet inputs need adaptation. Check that the sensitivity separation port is faithful before relying on it.

name: openai/math lean/OAI/Combinatorics/Sensitivity (Paper320)
provides: 50 files. Paper320.flip, sensitivityAt, sensitivity, blockSensitivityAt, blockSensitivity for f : (I -> Bool) -> Bool over any Fintype I. Theorems quantitative_separation (bs/s^2 >= 2^d/(4(d+2)^2)), unbounded_quadratic_separation, fixed_power_separation (exists alpha>2, s^alpha <= bs at the zero input). Supporting: Composition, Recursive*, Tower, Tournament, Labeling*, PowerAmplification, HammingBase.
maintenance_state: active mirror of OpenAI math release; Sensitivity directory frozen since 2026-10-06.
notes: The cslib-community port already adopts the separation, so depend on that where possible. This repo is a monolithic library (compile small portions). The paper under study is a different OpenAI release; it was not located in CONTENTS.md by keyword and no query-complexity separation formalisation was found in this repo.

name: mathlib4 (Boolean characters, Hadamard matrices, Markov, Hamming, PMF, Huang archive)
provides: Matrix.IsHadamard (structure, new 2026) with IsHadamard.kronecker, four_dvd_card, det_ne_zero, of_mul_conjTranspose. AddChar orthogonality: AddChar.expect_eq_ite, wInner_cWeight_eq_boole (characters of finite abelian groups, usable for (ZMod 2)^n); Analysis/Fourier/FiniteAbelian/PontryaginDuality. Markov: MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_lintegral, meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (also ChebyshevMarkov for Lp); finite spaces via counting measure or PMF. hammingDist and triangle lemmas. PMF with PMF.toOuterMeasure; setBernoulli. HasSubgaussianMGF (Hoeffding-style tools; exact Hoeffding statement not verified). Archive/Sensitivity.lean: Huang's lemma on hypercube (adjacent, V n, degree). Chebyshev polynomials. No Boolean-function Fourier library, decision trees or query complexity in Mathlib proper.
paper_needs_covered: Fourier characters on the cube (via AddChar)
Huang hypercube lemma (Archive only, not importable)
notes: Archive/ is not part of the Mathlib library import, so the Huang lemma must be copied or taken from complexitylib/SamuelSchlesinger. Mathlib files were located by tree filename grep; the grep did not surface any BooleanFunction, DecisionTree or Walsh module.
